assay: bulk poly(A) RNA-seq, Illumina PE (S2.16.p1); GEO: NovaSeq X Plus PE150, HISAT2 + StringTie2, mm10
sample_inclusion: C2C12 myoblasts treated 24 h with mEVs isolated from TA muscle of SED, CE (uphill) or EE (downhill) trained mice (6 wk, S2.5.p1); N = 3 per group (S3.8.p1, FIG8 legend)

factors.name: grp (EV source)
factors.type: between-well, in vitro treatment; exercise acts through the EV donor muscle

primary_estimand: Transcriptomic effect on C2C12 myoblasts of muscle-derived EVs from exercised mice (concentric CE, eccentric EE) versus EVs from sedentary mice, and EE- versus CE-derived EVs. Exercise is the treatment of the EV-donor mice; the sequenced cells were not exercised.

planned_contrasts.name: grp_CE_vs_SED
planned_contrasts.definition: CE-mEV vs SED-mEV (volcano 'SED and CE', FIG8b left)

planned_contrasts.name: grp_EE_vs_CE
planned_contrasts.definition: EE-mEV vs CE-mEV (volcano 'CE and EE', FIG8b right)

direction_note: FIG8c overlaps genes up in CE vs SED and up in EE vs CE ('sequential increase', S3.8.p1)

blocking_or_covariance.note: independent culture replicates; no batch/pairing reported

matrix_scale: gene-level read counts from StringTie2 (GEO data_processing); FPKM/TPM also deposited

reported_counts.overlap_up: nine fatty-acid-metabolism genes increase sequentially SED<CE<EE (S3.8.p1), incl. Prkag3, Cox7a1, Cox6a2, Cox8b

enrichment.method: GO and KEGG enrichment of DEGs (S2.16.p1, FIG8a)
